overview: An archaeological revolution has been taking place over the last 15 years and technology is at its beating heart. Archaeologists once excavated ancient ruins with little more than oral texts, haphazard plans, and aerial photographs to guide them. This series explores the massive changes technological innovation has brought to the discipline. It is now pushing the boundaries of archaeological discovery and our understanding of what once was. Thanks to the development of drones, lidar, radar, 3D technology and more, each episode brings a variety of archaeological finds to life and explores how groundbreaking research is casting a new light on ancient civilizations.
title: Scanning History

overview: "WATCH Out!" is the first big series about the comic book industry in Russia.
title: БДЫЩ!

overview: "THIS IS LOVE" is a new romantic detective show from Medium Quality, where Roman Kagramanov tests the love intuition of the star guests.
title: ЭТО ЛЮБОВЬ

overview: The series is set 35 years after the events of the original film and is focused on a dangerous heist crew with ties to the Ex-Presidents gang.
title: Point Break

overview: Pagans follows a man who becomes the sole caretaker of his two children after the tragic loss of his wife. While his son is typical, his daughter, Alice, is anything but. What starts as a strained father-daughter relationship soon evolves into something far more sinister. Equal parts emotional, horrifying and humorous, Pagans is a show that unearths all our darkest thoughts about family.
title: Pagans

overview: Graciela, an ambitious and empowered professional, has a wonderful, passionate night. The problem is that the man she spent it with, Mateo, turns out to be her main rival for the CEO position at the company to which she has dedicated the last several years of her life. What begins as a fierce professional battle soon becomes a personal challenge. As they fight for the job of their dreams, both will discover that the person they see as their greatest obstacle might be the answer to everything they've been searching for.
title: Amor de oficina

overview: Excruciating, hilarious and plain embarrassing TV clips.
title: The Most Embarrassing TV Moments

overview: This Christmas on RTÉ One, join Eva Pau for Christmas with an Asian twist! Across two episodes filled with festive sparkle, Eva will serve up a delicious Christmas feast and an array of irresistible party food to keep your family and guests coming back for more!
title: Eva Pau's Asian Christmas

overview: Pope Leo XIV delivers his Christmas Message and Blessing to the Vatican City and to the World, with commentary and translation by Lydia O'Kane.
title: Urbi Et Orbi: Pope Leo's Christmas Message

overview: The Catholic and Church of Ireland Primates of All Ireland, Archbishop Eamon Martin and Archbishop John McDowell, offer a seasonal message and blessing.
title: The Archbishops' Christmas Message

overview: Bajo la misma piel is a story of love and heartbreak, friendship and betrayal, freedom and emotional ties, rivalries, hatred, and intrigue. But above all, it is the story of women who fight for their ideals, to be authentic, and to feel satisfied with themselves, without being in any man's shadow. Miranda, Regina, Sara, and Esther are very different and belong to different generations, but they still have something in common: none of them is willing to sacrifice true love.
title: Bajo la misma piel

overview: Chilling drama series where every day counts. In series 3, Lies and secrets come to the surface when the brothers and sisters of Dolwen come together to scatter their mother's ashes and to discuss the future of the family estate. Welcome to Dolwen – a grand old house which is the location of the new series of murder mystery 35 Diwrnod, starting Sunday, 5 March. The Dolwen farm family haven't been together since celebrating their father's 60th birthday five years previously. Many dreams are shattered when the children suspect that their uncle Huw persuaded their mother to change her will. As they challenge him and demand to have the land back in their hands, jealousy and violence bring a dark cloud over Dolwen farm.
title: 35 Diwrnod

overview: Luciana, a psychologist, is torn between love and loyalty. After being rescued from a robbery by prosecutor Roberto Roldán, they feel a strong connection. However, Roberto is investigating a hit-and-run involving Adrián Ferrer, whose father, Enrique Ferrer, is the presidential candidate and Luciana's godfather. As Roberto gets closer to the truth, Enrique's future is at risk. Luciana must choose between supporting Roberto in his quest for justice or protecting her family.
title: Juegos de Amor y Poder

overview: HBO Sports, NFL Films and the Seattle Seahawks team up for an all-access look at what it takes to make it in the National Football League when the first sports-based reality series - and one of the fastest-turnaround programs on TV.
title: Hard Knocks

overview: The Mark Twain Prize for American Humor (aka: The Mark Twain Prize) is an American award for humor awarded by the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts annually since 1998. It is named after the 19th century novelist, essayist and humorist Mark Twain and is presented to an individual who has made a significant contribution to American humor. The prize is presented and show is taped in the Kennedy Center Concert Hall in Washington DC, during which the honoree is celebrated by his or her peers. The event is a significant fundraiser to benefit the Kennedy Center, which sells tickets as well as access to dinners and after-parties featuring the celebrities. Recipients of the Twain Prize receive a copy of an 1884 bronze portrait bust of Mark Twain sculpted by Karl Gerhardt (1853-1940).
title: Mark Twain Prize for American Humor

overview: The Dylan Ratigan Show was an opinion and analysis-fueled daily broadcast program airing weekdays.
title: The Dylan Ratigan Show

overview: Inagaw na Bituin is about how the brightness of stolen dreams can be restored through the struggle of life. The marriage of Eduard and Belinda will be tested after their only child, Anna, is kidnapped. With their real child gone, they will focus their attention and love on their niece, Lucy's daughter, Ariela. Meanwhile, Anna will grow up as Elsa with Aurora. Because of music, the paths of their families will cross. Whose star between Anna and Ariela will shine brighter? Will they be able to regain the memories and stolen dreams they have lost? Watch out for all of that in Inagaw na Bituin.
title: Inagaw na Bituin

overview: The God of the Woods is a multigenerational drama series set in the Adirondacks. It explores the Van Laar family's dark secrets, class tensions, and the mysterious disappearance of 13-year-old Barbara Van Laar from her family's summer camp — in the wake of an earlier family tragedy that may be related. As the past and present collide, the Van Laars' wealth and influence unravel, revealing the damaging consequences of privilege and the abuse of power.
title: The God of the Woods

overview: What does Christmas mean to some of our best-loved personalities? Anita Rani meets famous faces to hear how their festive memories reflect their lives, careers and faith.
title: My Life at Christmas with Anita Rani

overview: Estranged couple, Emman and Celine, is brought together by the disappearance of their son, Robbie, only to find the love that they have lost in the past.
title: Walang Hanggang Paalam

overview: Hell Week is a raw, emotional and uncompromising reality series where 13 of Norway's most high-profile athletes voluntarily throw themselves into an extreme military simulation - inspired by the special forces entrance exams and the Norwegian Armed Forces' most demanding course.
title: Helvetesuka

overview: Janne Formoe and Triana Iglesias embark on a thrilling journey of discovery into the world of sex. Here they meet people who openly share their sexual experiences, and colorful experts who give them deeper knowledge about sex, sexuality, and sensuality.
title: Bedre sex

overview: Doucheaholics Anonymous is an international fellowship of men and women who exhibit poor behavior and want to better themselves in a supportive, healing, and nurturing environment. Unfortunately, with this group the environment is often not supporting, healing, nor nurturing. This series explores and satirizes the different personality archetypes that make us human.
title: Doucheaholics

overview: Host Bernt Hulsker invites 14 sports stars to a prestigious quiz show. There will be questions from the world of sports, general knowledge, clever fun facts and lots of competitive instinct.
title: Norges smarteste idrettsstjerne

overview: In Inspektørene (en.: The Inspectors), we get to follow the inspectors of the Mattilsynet (Norwegian Food Safety Authority) up close for the first time, in a dramatic and unvarnished encounter with a reality that most of us never get to know. The Norwegian Food Safety Authority is one of Norway's most important, and least known, emergency response agencies. They are responsible for everything that goes in and on our bodies, such as food, drinks, cosmetics and creams – in addition to animal welfare in Norway. They close restaurants, inspect food factories and stop dangerous imports at the border. Sometimes they have to kill animals that are illegally smuggled into the country, and respond when farms are affected by infectious diseases. Through eight episodes, Inspectors shows the people who make the toughest decisions when safety, health and lives are at stake.
title: Inspektørene

overview: Skjærgårdsfeber follows boating enthusiasts in, on, and around the Oslofjord. The archipelago is where summer dreams meet reality, the sea spray is fresh, and the boaters' maneuvering skills vary dramatically. In Archipelago Fever, every bay, every cape, every headland and every harbor is explored – from idyllic gems to places where you should rather not dock. There is sun, rocky shores, swimming, screaming seagulls and just the right amount of drama.
title: Skjærgårdsfeber

overview: In the new workplace reality series, Spenningens Helter (en.: Heroes of Excitement), we get a rare insight into the tasks that fitters face, and the effort that makes Norway work – even when everything else comes to a standstill.
title: Spenningens helter

overview: Who emerges victorious when five of Norway's best comedians face the world's worst audience?
title: Verdens verste publikum

overview: Can you joke about everything? Comedian Lars Berrum tests where the line is after getting to know people who are not allowed to laugh at.
title: Tabu

overview: Everything goes to hell when a group of siblings have to work together to organize a wedding with 3,000 guests.
title: Heajastallan

overview: How hard should parent coaches push their children? This series explores the boundaries between support and unhealthy pressure – with insights from profiles such as Ståle Solbakken, Team Northug, Jæger, Kristoff and Mol.
title: Pappatreneren

overview: For three years, the police infiltrated the life of mother of seven Elisabeth Aaslie and eventually had her convicted of two murders.
title: Jakten på Norges farligste kvinne

overview: In a fjord community facing the closure of its only police station, detective Ole Vik gets an oddly timed new trainee whose arrival coincides with something far darker than small-town life should ever see.
title: Mord i Sogn

overview: Petter Nyquist wants to start a command center for good deeds in the middle of the municipal housing in Torshov. But will he get the residents on board with the idea?
title: Petters kommandosentral

overview: Ke Yuruo gave up her dream of dancing for her parents and entered a seven-year loveless business marriage with the Xu family, only to discover her husband Xu Zichen's affair. She decided to end the marriage. Her mother-in-law, Xu Lan, plotted to seize the Ke family fortune and enlisted Li Haoqing, a former member of Ke's dance troupe who had long loved her. Though appearing to work for Xu Lan, he secretly helped Ke. Ke's best friend Shen Yan, who was in love with Xu Zichen, was manipulated by Xu Lan. But Shen eventually chose to help Ke under repeated pressure. Moved by Shen Yan's suffering, Xu Zichen repented. With the help of friends such as Fu Wan, Ke Yuruo defeated Xu Lan, reclaimed her family's assets, and ultimately found happiness with Li Haoqing.
title: Love Me Tender

overview: Bear and his friends live in the Big Blue House, where Bear helps his house-mates to solve everyday problems or learn new things. In addition to spending time with the house-mates (Treelo the lemur, Ojo the bear cub, Tutter the mouse, and Pip and Pop the otters) bear also takes time out to listen to Shadow's tales and ends each day by reflecting on the lessons learned and singing 'The Goodbye Song' with Luna the moon.
title: Bear in the Big Blue House

overview: In Yuezun Kingdom, women held power and inheritance followed the strict rule of "to daughters, never to sons." Pei family, a century-old master of incense-making, owned a priceless ancestral incense manual that countless people had sought in vain. Forced to steal it, the "female thief" Song Zhiyao was caught on the spot by Pei Jingheng, the Pei family's second young master. To keep the manual from leaking, he kept her by his side. As they spent time together, affection quietly grew. Later, Song Zhiyao recovered the brutal memories of her clan's massacre and uncovered many hidden truths about the Pei family. In the end, the two resolved their misunderstandings.
title: The Glory of Queen
This County Lord is About to Get Promoted

overview: The Christmas story for everyone, live from Maastricht. The biblical Christmas story comes to life in a heartwarming way in the nativity scene on Onze Lieve Vrouweplein.
title: De kerststal van Nederland

overview: We follow five households with financial problems. Stress about money dominates their lives. And the more their debts mount up, the less control they have. John Williams and his team of experts work with the participants to get their lives back on track.
title: Uit De Schulden

overview: In the eyes of others, Daan is a ‘depraved' mother who muddles through and has no idea what good parenting is. After her divorce, Daan ends up on her mother's couch. In order not to lose her children for good, she has to take a parenting course.
title: Moedermaffia!

overview: When a hip hop legend vanishes before his waffle joint's opening, his oddball crew must crack the case, wondering if one of them could be the culprit.
title: Mo' Waffles

overview: In the student council room, you'll never find more than two people: the president, Haiya Gin (that's me), and the vice president, Kurishita Namida. We used to have a bunch of other officers too, but since the vice president took care of everything so easily, everyone stopped coming. She's incredibly beautiful, and an honor student with no flaws to speak of, but... For some reason, she's always messing with me, and only me?! A comedy featuring the antics of a strangely doting, tall vice president and an adorably tiny president begins!!!
title: The Main and Favourite Duties of Ms. Kurishita

overview: Dr. Nancy Snyderman shares her unique journey as a practicing surgeon and broadcast journalist, emphasizing the passion for medicine and the opportunities it offers.
title: Dr. Nancy

overview: Dr. Peter Brown, an intern at Boston's worst hospital who has a talent for medicine, works a shift from hell and has a past he'd prefer to keep hidden. But when a patient recognizes him from his dangerous past, Brown has eight hours to elude the government, mob hitmen, quack surgeons and a trail of dead gangers to beat the reaper somehow.
title: Beat the Reaper

overview: So Far Gone follows Rhys Kinnick, a reclusive journalist whose self-imposed exile in the woods is upended when his long-estranged grandchildren arrive on his doorstep after their mother disappears. When the children are kidnapped by a cult connected to their father, Rhys must re-enter the fractured world he abandoned. Joined by a bipolar retired detective and a sharp-tongued ex-girlfriend, he embarks on a wild and suspenseful quest to save them and track down his missing daughter, rediscovering his own capacity for connection along the way.
title: So Far Gone

overview: Bakers team up with their sweetie pies to create ultrarealistic cakes and hoodwink celebrity judges in this special Valentine's Day edition.
title: Is It Cake? Valentines

overview: Are you a good person or a bad person? Elementary schoolmates gather for a reunion. A graduation yearbook with six faces blacked out is unearthed from a time capsule. Suddenly, the suspicious deaths of classmates begin. Who is responsible, and for what purpose? Two of them start to investigate in an attempt to stop the incidents, but they also have secrets of their own… Classmates who are now suspects—will the real culprit be revealed? An unpredictable, thought-provoking mystery begins.
title: The Right to Judge

overview: The head of a talent agency races to stop an exposé that could end her client's career — pitting her against the reporter determined to break the story.
title: Scandal Eve

overview: The Ed Show was a political talk show hosted by the nationally syndicated talk-radio personality Ed Schultz on the MSNBC news channel.
title: The Ed Show

overview: The Casillas Dynasty saga continues as the family faces a ruthless game of power and betrayal following patriarch Aurelio's disappearance.
title: Dinastía Casillas

overview: Tom Read Wilson's Magnificent Journey reimagines the rite of passage once undertaken by 17th, 18th and 19th-century aristocrats on their Grand Tours of Europe. Now, nearly 40 and craving a touch of cultural enlightenment, Tom Read Wilson sets out to follow in their footsteps. With a heart full of wanderlust and a taste for timeless beauty, Tom embarks on his own Grand Tour, armed with his Super 8 camera and travelling from Paris to Rome to become schooled in art & architecture and enriched in history and culture. It's a series brimming with beauty, wit, and the enduring joy of lifelong learning.
title: Tom Read Wilson's Magnificent Journey

overview: Jane says she's "a woman of a certain age" but in this series she's determined not to let that define her. And she's proving it by throwing herself into her Pole to Pole adventure and grabbing every opportunity with both hands.
title: Jane McDonald: From Pole to Pole

overview: The Most with Alison Stewart focused on the top news stories of the day people are looking at on MSNBC.com. In addition, the program also aired "the most watched or sought after" material on the Internet, including the most watched viral videos of the day.
title: The Most with Alison Stewart

overview: A gloriously messy dad and his equally unfiltered family cause chaos when they try to fit in with the snobby families at their fancy new school.
title: Free Bert

overview: We live in a divided country. A country where many cannot talk to those with whom they disagree. Where people can't speak across the political divide – or even sometimes across the kitchen table. Things That Matter aims to change that. Sponsored by Bank of America, Things That Matter is a series of town halls and debates that will feature the people in politics and culture who are shaping American life. The events will be held across the country, in front of audiences who have a stake in the topics under discussion. The events take Americans into the most important issues that directly affect their lives – immigration, capitalism, public health, criminal justice, foreign policy, artificial intelligence and the state of politics. The debates echo the country's 250th anniversary, showing how the power of America's earliest principles – civil, substantive discussion, free of rancor – have immense value today.
title: Things That Matter

overview: After several years, Adrián and Mariana meet again at La Encantada, and just when they think their lives are settled, they realise they've never stopped loving each other. They must fight against those who seek to separate them.
title: Sin pecado concebido

overview: Two worlds are about to collide. Brace yourself for an incredible hour of drama, as the nation's best-loved characters crossover in an explosive soap special.
title: Corriedale

overview: Innato tells the story of Sara, a psychologist who has left behind a traumatic past as the daughter of Félix Garay, a serial killer once dubbed by the press as "the diesel killer." Now, the idyllic life Sara has built with her husband Aitor and their teenage son Sebas begins to crumble when Félix is released from prison — just as a new wave of crimes appears to replicate the murders committed 25 years earlier. After hiding her past from her family for years, Sara must now work with the police to solve the new cases.
title: Innato

overview: When a criminal performs astral projection to switch physical body with her cousin, a life will be stolen and forced to be imprisoned. The cousin will plan to regain her family and life.
title: Stolen Life

overview: A happily married mother faces an emotional crisis when her ex-boyfriend unexpectedly returns to her life, forcing her to confront past feelings and question her commitment to her family.
title: My Faithful Husband

overview: Sometimes we find love in the most unexpected places, and it comes in the most unexpected moment. Can two broken hearts make their love last?
title: A Love to Last

overview: Alice, a fresh graduate, meets her intense and alluring boss Nannalin. As boundaries blur between work, desire, and power, Alice must decide—escape her demanding boss or surrender under her rules?
title: Under her rules

overview: Follow investigative officer Li Rongwei as he outsmarts the "Outstanding Entrepreneur" Gao Tianyu, uncovering layer by layer the dark schemes behind "beauty loans" and "senior investment" traps!
title: The Hidden ID

overview: Building a house is more than just bricks and mortar, it's also about dreams and aspirations, design and execution, making Memories and mistakes.
title: Beyond the Build

overview: Su Jinli, a headstrong princess, is transported into a game world where danger, betrayal, and hidden rules govern her fate. As assassins close in and the system itself turns unstable, she joins forces with Yun Lang to uncover the truth behind the game and find a way back to reality.
title: A Happy Life

overview: After Huo Zhongren, the registrar of Muxi City, goes missing in the palace, his daughter, Huo Xiangjiu, infiltrates the palace as a maid to investigate. Amid inexplicable incidents one after another, she discovers that Feng Mochen, a powerful and favored court official, is actually a thousand-year-old fox spirit, and their souls even swap by accident. Are there other spirits stirring trouble, or is it the doing of wicked mortals? With their own agendas, Xiangjiu and Mochen join hands to solve a series of strange cases with a comical flair, while also uncovering an affecting love story, spanning over seven lifetimes, that has been buried for a thousand years.
title: Eternal Love of the Fox

overview: Somewhere in medieval Flanders, the optimistic jester Diederik and his half-sister Marie find shelter in the castle of Countess Isabella. There they struggle with forbidden love, toxic nobles, and a mysterious secret from their past.
title: ZOT!

overview: When the blistering Arizona sun finally sets over Tucson's Sonoran Desert, the temperature drops—and the crime rises. With elite access to the Pima County Sheriff's Department serving the seventh-largest county in the nation, "Desert Law" follows the high-intensity work of its patrol deputies, DUI unit, and night detectives as they cover more than 9,000 square miles of unforgiving rugged terrain. Taking on the trouble that thrives after dark, the series immerses viewers in the pressure and danger of policing the desert night, capturing a world where the spirit of the Old West still lingers and the fight for order never ends.
title: Desert Law

overview: Wishing to escape from the chaos of his life, Makorn finds a house to rent. It has all the amenities but a refrigerator. He buys one second hand, and that night, Makorn gets a shock when he opens the fridge and his hand meets with another on the other side. The hand's owner is Pleo, a 29-year-old with a painful past. Once they each recover from their shock, they talk and discover they're communicating across different times. For Pleo, it's still Thai year 2550, more than seventeen years earlier. Together, Pleo and Makorn must join forces on a mission to travel back in time and try to rewrite the events that shaped their lives.
title: The Fridge

overview: Dive inside the enigmatic world of water, which shapes all life on Earth.
title: Inside the Enchanted Waterways

overview: When the new far-right government decides to send back everyone not born here, Muna & Jamal risk it all by entering 'The Best Immigrant', a ruthless game show with the grand prize... a residency permit.
title: The Best Immigrant
